formal_shape_evidence.finding: Section 2.1 distinguishes multiple-choice tasks, whose formal statements include all options, from tasks whose solution was previously supplied inside a formal statement. For the latter, v2c replaces the solution with a sorry placeholder for the prover to fill. Metadata does not support assuming every find-answer task is a fixed existential proposition with only a proof-body hole.
formal_shape_evidence.implementation_implication: The current worker only replaces a proof body for an immutable declaration. Filling answer holes inside a declaration would change those bytes; it needs an explicitly reviewed typed answer-slot/witness-binding design rather than silently relabeling the current proof-only interface. A correct separate answer string plus a proof of an options disjunction remains insufficient to bind that answer.
